title: bot-Hq trading catalog v0
description: One-component catalog for the A2UI 1.0 OrderTicket MVP (paper trading only). It has no $id on purpose: like the upstream conformance catalogs, it is registered in place of the envelope's sibling catalog.json, so its relative common_types.json references resolve to the official v1.0 common types.
instructions: OrderTicket is always the surface root (id 'root'). Account and position values are owned by the agent and bound with @path into /account; the renderer never writes /account. Field edits are reported to the agent as an action named 'ticketEdited' (sourceComponentId 'root', context {side, quantity, limitPrice}). The submit property must only fire from a real user click.

OrderTicket.description: Limit order ticket for one YES-contract market. side is 'buy' or 'sell'; quantity is whole contracts; prices are dollars in 0.01..0.99.

livePrice.description: Live YES price in dollars, pushed by the agent.

position.description: Server-side net YES position in contracts (display only).

status.description: Binding to the ticket status object {state, message, orderId}.

submit.description: Must be a functionCall of submitOrder (an event action or any other function is rejected).

submitOrder.description: Places one PAPER limit order for the ticket. Executed by the agent; the agent derives the idempotency key, so the renderer never sends one. requiresUserActivation is evidenced by args.userActivation, which the renderer fills from the DOM event of the click that fired the call (it is not part of the component's bound args). That evidence is client-supplied, so the agent treats it as a hint, not proof.

Side.description: Order side: a literal 'buy' | 'sell', or a data binding to one.

Quantity.description: Whole contracts (1..10000), or a data binding to them.

Price.description: Dollars per YES contract (0.01..0.99), or a data binding to it.

UserActivation.description: Client-supplied evidence of the user activation that triggered a call: the DOM event type, its isTrusted flag and when it happened. Required by the agent for functions with requiresUserActivation:true; the agent rejects missing, untrusted, stale (>120 s) or future-dated (>30 s) evidence. It is a hint that stops accidental or agent-originated calls, not proof of a real click: socket access is controlled by the transport token.
